title: Add regression tests for tool-argument bounds and verify with probe-schemas
description: In the same checkout, add vitest regression cases (one per new bound: string maxLength, operator allowlist, documents maxItems, stdio payload cap) so the blocking unit-tests CI gate catches this class of defect, then re-run the probe-schemas workflow against mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server on the merged main commit (not the pre-fix pinned aaa72a040db4c32f3d6488d5e28e2892a68e9ee0) and confirm rule SCH-API-02 no longer fires at src/tools/args.ts; attach the PR url(s) and the probe SARIF export as task evidence. Constraints: the probe must target the merged commit; no deployment windows or change freeze are configured in sdlc/policy.json.
acceptanceCriteria: The vitest suite contains at least one regression case per new bound (string maxLength, operator allowlist, documents maxItems, stdio payload cap) and the blocking unit-tests CI gate passes on main
A probe-schemas run against the merged main commit produces no SCH-API-02 result at src/tools/args.ts
Task evidence contains the merged PR url(s) and the probe-schemas SARIF export path

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-schemas on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server against the merged main commit: expected result - rule SCH-API-02 yields no result at src/tools/args.ts and the refreshed sebi-cscrf-2024:PR.IP.S2 observation records the fix.

rootCause.description: First-party TypeScript code trusted MCP tool-argument input and no CI gate or test asserted bounds on it, so the SCH-API-02 defect reached the deployed gateway; this task closes the loop on that insecure code path with regression tests and a re-probe.
